#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long inv(long long a) {
    long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
    long long r = a;
    while (r != 0) {
        long long q = g / r;
        g %= r;
        long long tmp = g;
        g = r;
        r = tmp;
        x -= q * y;
        tmp = x;
        x = y;
        y = tmp;
    }
    x %= MOD;
    if (x < 0) x += MOD;
    return x;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    int max_fact = n + m;
    vector<long long> fact(max_fact + 1), invFact(max_fact + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max_fact; i++) {
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }

    invFact[max_fact] = inv(fact[max_fact]);
    for (int i = max_fact; i >= 1; i--) {
        invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD;
    }

    auto ncr = [&](int n, int r) -> long long {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invFact[r] % MOD * invFact[n - r] % MOD;
    };

    auto add = [](long long a, long long b) -> long long {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
    };

    auto subtract = [](long long a, long long b) -> long long {
        long long v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
    };

    auto smallInv = [&](int x) -> long long {
        return inv(x);
    };

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
        p = p * (n - i) % MOD * smallInv(n + m - i) % MOD;
        phaseSize = add(phaseSize, p);
        if (p == 0) break;
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long numPhases = (m + k) % MOD * smallInv(k) % MOD;
        long long e = numPhases * phaseSize % MOD;
        long long term = ncr(n, k) * e % MOD;

        if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            answer = add(answer, term);
        } else {
            answer = subtract(answer, term);
        }
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
